summary: Introduces steps for using ansible-test with Docker Desktop on WSL2 when systemd is not enabled; if WSL2 has systemd, the steps are unnecessary.
questions: Do I need extra setup to run ansible-test on WSL2 with Docker Desktop?
Does ansible-test work on Windows with WSL2?

answer_card.title: ansible-test on WSL2 with Docker Desktop
answer_card.answer_md: Extra setup is only needed when your WSL2 environment does **not** have `systemd` support. If systemd is enabled in WSL2, you can use `ansible-test --docker` without these steps.
